description:
Cast Ganax either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Sarkhan trigger. 
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Ganax.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, causing it to become a copy of Ganax whose name is still Sarkhan, Soul Aflame until end of turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Ganax by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Sarkhan trigger.
Resolve the Ganax and Sarkhan triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Ganax.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
